claim_boundary: This is a failed public-evidence funnel, not a validation result. Sentinel-1 radiometric processing is evidence QA, not model calibration. No prediction, AvaFrame calibration, partitioning, or holdout evaluation was run.
evaluation_order: anonymous source audit; imagery acquisition; radiometric/terrain processing; pixel QA; packet blinding; target-source access; two isolated AI proposal passes; human-review gate; release-state freeze; terrain acquisition; v3 evaluation
prototype_disclaimer: Experimental research prototype only. It does not replace Avalanche Canada guidance or field assessment. Scores are relative indices, not probabilities.

stop_decision.reason: Fewer than 12 eligible events across six paths, two mountains, and three storms.

validation_contract.evaluation_mode: pre-ingestion evidence checklist against v3 requirements; no incomplete ValidationDataset is fabricated
